title: Weighted Lebesgue-point and Besicovitch-density limits as H-integrals, a.e. on M₁ ∩ M₂ ∩ B_r(y)
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M₁ M₂ : Set (Eucl P)) (θ₁ θ₂ : Eucl P → ℝ) (y : Eucl P) (r : ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M₁ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → NullMeasurableSet M₂ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ z ∈ M₁, 0 < θ₁ z) → (∀ z ∈ M₂, 0 < θ₂ z) → IntegrableOn θ₁ (M₁ ∩ closedBall y r) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → IntegrableOn θ₂ (M₂ ∩ closedBall y r) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M₁ ∩ M₂ ∩ ball y r)), Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (∫⁻ z in M₁ ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ₁ z) * ‖(M₁ ∩ M₂).indicator (fun w => θ₂ w / θ₁ w) z - θ₂ x / θ₁ x‖ₑ ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) / (∫⁻ z in M₁ ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ₁ z) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) ∧ Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (∫⁻ z in M₁ ∩ M₂ ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ₂ z) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) / (∫⁻ z in M₂ ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ₂ z) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)
